title: Make the Today screen responsive
prompt: You have a static Today screen with everything placed by hand. Put these steps in the order you would follow to make it adapt from a 360 px to a 440 px phone, the way Sofia does it.
hints: You cannot set Fill container until the children sit inside an auto layout frame.
Testing comes after the structure is in place, and fixes go into the original, not the test copies.
Design, wrap content, set fills, pin edges and check the rows stretch, then test widths, then stress content, then fix.
explanation: Start from one well-made **mid-size design** so you have something worth adapting. Wrap the flowing parts in a **vertical auto layout content frame**, because Fill container only exists for children of auto layout. Then set rows and text to **Fill container** width so they stretch. Next, add **constraints** in the screen frame for the content frame and the pinned elements; the quick drag check only shows rows stretching because their fills are already set. Only now do you **resize copies** to the narrowest and widest widths, then **stress the content** with long names, empty lists and larger text. Finally **fix the original** and delete the copies, so there is still one source of truth.

items.design-mid: Design the screen at a mid-size width such as 393 px.
items.content-frame: Wrap header, progress and habit list in a vertical auto layout Content frame.
items.fill-children: Set the rows and text inside Content to Fill container width.
items.constraints: Set constraints (Content: Left and right, Top and bottom; tab bar: Left and right, Bottom; add button: Right, Bottom), then drag the screen wider to check the rows stretch with it.
items.resize-copies: Duplicate the screen and resize the copies to 360 and 440 px wide.
items.stress: Stress-test the copies with a long habit name, an empty list and text about 30% larger.
items.fix-original: Fix what broke in the original screen, then delete the test copies.
